# Hydration

Hydration is the weight of water divided by the weight of flour. A dough at 70 percent hydration is wetter and more open than one at 60 percent, and it sticks to the hands until the gluten has formed. Wholemeal flour drinks more water than white flour, so raise the hydration by a few points when you bake with it.
